page_title: SEV 1-1 VAL | Sevilla v Valencia 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Francisco Maeso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Substitution. Enzo Barrenechea is replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).

90+3' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla). He perfectly collected a pass from Albert Sambi Lokonga and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
86' The game has come to an end for Saul Niguez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Peque (Sevilla).
86' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is caught offside!

83' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
82' The referee points to the corner flag and Sevilla will take a corner.
82' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
82' The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
81' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Djibril Sow will be replaced by Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla).
78' Substitution. Andre Almeida makes way for Pepelu (Valencia).
78' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) replaces Kike Salas.
75' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Umar Sadiq (Valencia) receives a yellow card!
70' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francisco Maeso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
69' Here comes a substitution. Sergi Canos (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Diego Lopez.
69' Here is a change. Lucien Agoume is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Ruben Vargas (Sevilla).
69' Jose Angel Carmona comes off the pitch to be replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
69' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Hugo Duro is replaced by Umar Sadiq (Valencia).
68' Substitution. Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) on for Jose Gaya.
66' Sevilla have a goal ruled out for offside!
65' Luis Rioja (Valencia) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
64' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
63' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.

61' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Luis Rioja (Valencia) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:1. Orjan Nyland was helpless.
58' A cross from a corner kick by Sevilla is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
57' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
57' The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

57' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Giorgi Mamardashvili shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
56' Sevilla earn a corner.
56' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Hugo Duro (Valencia) sends a wild header high over the bar.
45+1' Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post.
37' A pass from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is intercepted by Orjan Nyland and the move breaks down.

35' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
34' What was Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
31' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Javi Guerra (Valencia) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
27' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly wide of the left post.
26' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia).
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.

24' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili! Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' A snap shot by Saul Niguez (Sevilla) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili produces a good save to thwart him.
18' Jose Gaya (Valencia) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
16' Jose Gaya (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Luis Rioja (Valencia) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
10' Luis Rioja (Valencia) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
9' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
7' Diego Lopez (Valencia) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
